The second query found no matches in the elliptic-curve directory. All 221 comparator Lean inputs were hash-checked; the independent rerun preserved the root and all 24 child interfaces, passed kernel checking, and reported only permitted transitive axioms.

theorems.statement: ∀ (W : WeierstrassCurve ℤ) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hΔ : W.Δ ≠ 0) (hW : W.IsSemistableModel) (hord : (p : ℤ) ∣ W.Δ ∨ ∃ i, 1 ≤ i ∧ i < (p ^ 2 - 1) / 2 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (W.preΨ' p).coeff i) (A : ValuationSubring (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (hA : A.LiesOverPrime p), ∃ L : Submodule (ZMod p) (Submodule.torsionBy ℤ ((W.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))⁄(AlgebraicClosure ℚ)).Point p), L ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ σ ∈ A.inertiaSubgroupIn ℚ, ∀ v : Submodule.torsionBy ℤ ((W.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ))⁄(AlgebraicClosure ℚ)).Point p, WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.galoisRepModuleEnd (K := AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ℚ (W.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) p σ v - v ∈ L
theorems.natural_summary: Construct a nonzero inertia-invariant additive map using specialization in good reduction and the accepted Tate uniformization in multiplicative reduction. Its kernel is the required proper submodule.
